No sanitizer exists on the export_sql -> create_db -> connection.execute chain (crud.py:142/209/180): the f-string performs no escaping of interpolated values. No HTTP/API request boundary exists in the analyzed code (nicegui runs in native desktop mode); the attacker-relevant input boundaries are the UI name prompt (ui.input -> Popen -> record CLI), the DB import channel (on_import replaces openadapt.db from a user-chosen bz2 file), the fire CLI, and operator-level env/config (not attacker input).

The DB round-trip is modeled by the db_read source labels at crud.py:142; end-to-end CLI-param tracking would need an additional summary step (flagged for human review).
